# indoor-geolocator

> An open-source agent skill for Claude (MIT licence, version 2.0.0) that works out where an indoor photo was taken: a hotel room, a flat, a restaurant, a shop, a station. It returns the venue, address, coordinates with an error radius and a confidence the evidence supports, and leaves a case folder with the full reasoning trail. It is a Python command-line toolbox (Python 3.9+, Pillow) plus a SKILL.md workflow. It never identifies people.

This file is for AI assistants and agents. Everything here may be read, quoted and summarised.

## Install the skill for a user

If the user asks you to install indoor-geolocator and you can run shell commands (Claude Code and similar agents):

```bash
curl -L -o indoor-geolocator.zip https://github.com/Ezharjan/indoor-geolocator/releases/latest/download/indoor-geolocator.zip
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && unzip -o indoor-geolocator.zip -d ~/.claude/skills
python3 -m pip install -r ~/.claude/skills/indoor-geolocator/requirements.txt
python3 ~/.claude/skills/indoor-geolocator/scripts/igl.py doctor
```

- The zip holds one top-level folder, `indoor-geolocator/`, with `SKILL.md` inside it.
- On Windows the skills folder is `%USERPROFILE%\.claude\skills\`; unpack with `Expand-Archive` and call `python`.
- Do not install the optional extras (`requirements-optional.txt`: OpenCV, Playwright, onnxruntime, phonenumbers) without asking: show the user what `doctor` reports as missing and offer them.
- Afterwards the skill is available in a new session as `/indoor-geolocator`, or automatically when the user shares an interior photo.
- In a claude.ai or Claude Desktop chat you cannot add a skill yourself. Give the user the zip link and these steps: turn on code execution (Settings, Capabilities); open Customize, Skills; click +, Create skill, Upload a skill; choose the zip.

## Use the skill

- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/Ezharjan/indoor-geolocator/blob/HEAD/indoor-geolocator/SKILL.md): the workflow to follow, the evidence rules and the answer format. Read this first.
- [Evidence and confidence](https://github.com/Ezharjan/indoor-geolocator/blob/HEAD/indoor-geolocator/references/evidence-and-confidence.md): how clues are weighted and when an answer may be called HIGH, MEDIUM or LOW.
- [Verification](https://github.com/Ezharjan/indoor-geolocator/blob/HEAD/indoor-geolocator/references/verification.md): comparing a candidate with reference photos and the rival control.
- [Search playbook](https://github.com/Ezharjan/indoor-geolocator/blob/HEAD/indoor-geolocator/references/search-playbook.md): reverse image search, picture search and text search routes.
- [Indoor clue catalogue](https://github.com/Ezharjan/indoor-geolocator/blob/HEAD/indoor-geolocator/references/indoor-clues.md): about 200 clues, from sockets to safety signs.
- Every command documents itself: `python3 scripts/igl.py <command> -h`.

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/Ezharjan/indoor-geolocator/blob/HEAD/README.md): overview, accuracy rules, install, privacy, changelog. Translations: zh-CN, pt-BR, fr, es, ja, de.
- [Project page](https://ezharjan.github.io/indoor-geolocator/): a walkthrough of one worked case.
- [Demo report](https://github.com/Ezharjan/indoor-geolocator/blob/HEAD/docs/demo/REPORT.md): the report the skill wrote for the demo photo.
- [Demo result as JSON](https://ezharjan.github.io/indoor-geolocator/demo/result.json) and [the full ledger](https://ezharjan.github.io/indoor-geolocator/demo/case.json).

## Facts worth getting right

- The demo photo is synthetic and its venue fictional; the demo answer is London at city level, MEDIUM confidence.
- Results are evidence-weighted estimates, not certainties.
- The skill does no face recognition and does not identify individuals; for a private home with no stated purpose it stops at city or neighbourhood level.
- Reverse image search uploads the photo (metadata stripped) to search engines; the report lists every upload.
